title: Get a free Japanese encephalitis vaccination
summary: Find out if you are eligible for a free Japanese encephalitis vaccination if you live or work in a flood-impacted area.
intro:
If you live or regularly work in a flood impacted area, it is recommended by NSW Health that you get vaccinated against Japanese encephalitis virus.

In NSW, wet conditions and stagnant water after floods creates a breeding ground for mosquitoes and can contribute to an increase in Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) cases.
who_can_apply: Live or routinely work in certain local government areas
Live or regularly work in a flood impacted area
what_you_need: To check eligibility, visit NSW Health.
To get the vaccination, speak to your General Practitioner (GP), pharmacist or Aboriginal Medical Service.

how_to_steps.text: Speak to your General Practitioner (GP), pharmacist or Aboriginal Medical Service about getting a vaccination.
Note: Some providers may charge an administration or consultation fee. Be sure to check if this applies to you.

faqs.q: Who should get vaccinated against Japanese encephalitis?
faqs.a: NSW Health recommends vaccination if you live or regularly work in a flood-impacted area.

faqs.q: How do I check if I am eligible for a free vaccination?
faqs.a: You must visit NSW Health to check your eligibility.

faqs.a: Speak to your General Practitioner (GP), pharmacist or Aboriginal Medical Service about getting a vaccination.
